title: OpenTelemetry Trace ID
summary: An OpenTelemetry trace ID is a 128-bit (16-byte) identifier that uniquely identifies a trace (a distributed request). Represented as 32 lowercase hex characters. All spans within a trace share the same trace ID.

notes: 128 bits (16 bytes), represented as 32 hex characters.
All spans within a trace share the same trace ID.
Trace IDs should be globally unique (randomly generated).
Used in distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin, Tempo).
W3C Trace Context: traceparent header carries the trace ID.
